pages.meta_description: Enterprise data management services from IndigeneTech: data pipelines, a central warehouse or lake, clear access rules and reports your teams can trust.
pages.intro: Your data is spread across spreadsheets, apps and old databases, and every report starts with a cleanup. We set up pipelines, a central warehouse or lake, and clear rules for who can see what, so your teams get numbers they can rely on. You work with a custom enterprise software development company led by Indigenous tech workers.
bullets: Free 30-minute call to map your data sources and goals
Strict NDAs keep your data and plans protected
Role-based access, encryption and audit logs from day one
Weekly demos so you see working reports early
pages.included_heading: What Our Enterprise Data Management Services Include

included.title: Data audit and roadmap
included.text: We list every source you rely on, check quality and duplicates, and agree on the reports that matter most. You get a short, phased plan with clear priorities.

included.title: Data pipelines
included.text: We move data from your apps, files and databases on a schedule or in near real time. Checks catch missing or broken records before they reach a report.

included.title: Central warehouse or lake
included.text: We set up one place for your business data on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, sized to what you need now and easy to grow later.

included.title: Master data and quality rules
included.text: One customer, one product, one supplier record. We define naming and matching rules so the same thing is not counted twice.

included.title: Access and governance
included.text: Role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit logs show who viewed or changed what. Retention rules match your policies.

included.title: Reports and dashboards
included.text: Trusted metrics for finance, operations and leadership, with self-serve views and alerts so teams stop waiting on manual exports.

pages.process_heading: How We Deliver Enterprise Data Management

process.title: Discover
process.text: A 30-minute call and a quick audit of your sources, owners and the decisions the data must support.

process.title: Design
process.text: We agree on the data model, quality rules, access roles and the first reports to deliver.

process.title: Build
process.text: Pipelines and the warehouse are built in small sprints, with weekly demos on real data.

process.title: Validate
process.text: We reconcile numbers against your current reports so your team trusts the new ones before switching.

process.title: Support
process.text: Monitoring, fixes and new sources as your business changes.

faqs.q: What is enterprise data management?
faqs.a: It is the set of tools and rules that keep business data accurate, consistent and secure across systems: pipelines that collect it, a central store, quality and naming rules, and controlled access. The goal is one trusted version of your numbers.

faqs.q: Do we have to replace our current systems?
faqs.a: No. We connect to the apps and databases you already use and pull data from them. Systems are replaced only if they block a goal, and that is agreed with you first.

faqs.q: Which platforms do you work with?
faqs.a: We build on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud and work with common databases, spreadsheets and business apps. The choice depends on what you already run, your budget and your data rules.

faqs.q: How do you keep sensitive data safe?
faqs.a: Role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, single sign-on, audit logs and backups are part of the build, not extras. We also agree on retention and who can export data.

faqs.q: How long does a first phase take?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of sources and their quality. After the audit you get a phased plan with milestones, starting with the reports that save your team the most time.

pages.meta_description: Software integration services that connect your ERP, CRM, POS, payments and HR systems with stable APIs, so data stays in sync and teams stop re-typing it.
pages.intro: When your tools do not talk to each other, people copy data by hand and mistakes creep in. We connect the systems you already use, ERP, CRM, POS, payments, HR and custom apps, with stable APIs that keep everything in sync. You work with a custom enterprise software development company led by Indigenous tech workers.
bullets: Free 30-minute call to map the systems you want connected
Strict NDAs keep your systems and data protected
Clear data mapping before any code is written
Monitoring and alerts so failed syncs never go unnoticed
pages.included_heading: What Our Software Integration Services Include

included.title: Integration audit
included.text: We map your systems, the data each one owns and where manual work happens today, then agree on which connections to build first.

included.title: API development
included.text: Secure, documented APIs for your custom systems, so other tools can read and update data without workarounds.

included.title: ERP and CRM integration
included.text: Orders, customers, invoices and stock move between your ERP and CRM automatically, with clear rules for which system is the source of truth.

included.title: Payments, POS and HR
included.text: Connect payment providers, point-of-sale and HR or payroll tools so sales, refunds and staff data stay consistent everywhere.

included.title: Data mapping and sync
included.text: We match fields and formats between systems and choose real-time or scheduled sync for each flow, with retries for temporary failures.

included.title: Monitoring and support
included.text: Logs, alerts and a simple status view show every sync. When a connected app changes, we update the integration.

process.title: Discover
process.text: A 30-minute call and an audit of your systems, data owners and manual steps.

process.title: Map
process.text: We document fields, formats, sync timing and error handling for each connection.

process.title: Build
process.text: Integrations are built and tested in small sprints against test copies of your systems.

process.title: Launch
process.text: We switch flows on in stages and watch the first runs closely.

process.title: Support
process.text: Monitoring, fixes and updates when a connected system changes its API.

faqs.q: Which systems can you integrate?
faqs.a: Most business tools with an API or export: ERP, CRM, POS, payment providers, HR and payroll, accounting, e-commerce and custom software. If a system has no API, we look at file exchange or database connections.

faqs.q: Real-time or scheduled sync?
faqs.a: It depends on the data. Payments and stock levels usually need near real-time updates; reports and history can sync on a schedule. We choose per flow and explain the trade-off.

faqs.q: What happens when a sync fails?
faqs.a: Failed messages are retried automatically and logged. If a problem persists, alerts go to the right people with enough detail to fix it, so data is not lost silently.

faqs.q: Can you work with our older systems?
faqs.a: Yes. Older systems often need an adapter or a small API layer. If a system is holding you back, we can plan a gradual modernization alongside the integration.

faqs.q: Who owns the integration code?
faqs.a: You do. You get the code, documentation and access, so you are never locked in.

pages.meta_description: Legacy application modernization that keeps what works: move old apps to modern stacks, improve UX and move to the cloud in phases, without stopping daily work.
pages.intro: Old applications often still run important work, but they are slow to change, hard to secure and costly to keep alive. We keep what works and fix what slows you down: modern stacks, better screens and a move to the cloud when it helps, in phases that do not stop your operations. You work with a custom enterprise software development company led by Indigenous tech workers.
bullets: Free 30-minute call to review the app you want to modernize
Strict NDAs protect your code and business rules
Step-by-step plan that keeps daily work running
Security fixes and cloud options built into the plan
pages.included_heading: What Our Legacy Application Modernization Services Include

included.title: Application assessment
included.text: We review code, data, integrations and risks, and show which parts to keep, refactor, rebuild or retire, with effort for each.

included.title: Refactoring and re-platforming
included.text: We move code to supported languages and frameworks, remove dead features and make the app easier and safer to change.

included.title: Cloud migration
included.text: When it helps, we move the app to AWS, Azure or Google Cloud with backups and a tested rollback plan.

included.title: UX and interface refresh
included.text: Clearer screens, faster forms and mobile-friendly layouts, so people get work done with fewer clicks.

included.title: Data migration
included.text: We move and clean historical data, check totals against the old system and keep an audit trail of the transfer.

included.title: Security hardening
included.text: Supported libraries, role-based access, encryption, single sign-on and audit logs replace outdated, risky components.

process.title: Assess
process.text: A 30-minute call and a review of the app, its users and the risks of change.

process.title: Plan
process.text: A phased roadmap that keeps the system running while parts are replaced.

process.title: Modernize
process.text: Work happens in small sprints with weekly demos and testing on real scenarios.

process.title: Switch over
process.text: Each part goes live with backups and a rollback plan, so operations keep running.

process.title: Support
process.text: Fixes, updates and further phases once the first ones are stable.

faqs.q: Do we have to rebuild the whole application?
faqs.a: Usually not. Many apps can be modernized step by step: keep the parts that work, refactor or replace the rest. The assessment shows the most cost-effective path.

faqs.q: Will modernization interrupt our work?
faqs.a: We plan it so it does not. Parts are switched over one at a time, with backups and a rollback plan, and the old system keeps running until the new part is proven.

faqs.q: Do we need to move to the cloud?
faqs.a: Not always. We recommend it when it lowers cost, improves reliability or makes scaling easier. If staying on your own servers makes more sense, we modernize in place.

faqs.q: What happens to our existing data?
faqs.a: We migrate and clean it, reconcile totals with the old system and keep a record of what moved, so nothing is lost and your team can check the results.

faqs.q: How do you estimate cost and time?
faqs.a: After the assessment you get a phased plan with effort per phase. You can start with the part that causes the most pain and decide on later phases as you go.

pages.seo_title: Software Maintenance and Support Services | IndigeneTech
pages.meta_description: Software maintenance and support after launch: updates, bug fixes, uptime checks, backups and security patches under clear service levels and quick response.
pages.intro: Software needs care after launch. Libraries age, browsers change and small bugs pile up. We handle updates, bug fixes, uptime checks, backups and security patches, with clear service levels and a friendly team that responds quickly. You work with a custom enterprise software development company led by Indigenous tech workers.
bullets: Free 30-minute call to review your application and needs
Clear service levels for response and fixes
Security patches and backups handled for you
Plain monthly updates on what was done
pages.included_heading: What Our Software Maintenance and Support Services Include

included.title: Bug fixes
included.text: Issues are logged, prioritized and fixed according to the agreed service levels, with a clear note of what changed.

included.title: Security patches and updates
included.text: We keep frameworks, libraries and servers up to date and apply security patches before they become problems.

included.title: Monitoring and uptime checks
included.text: Uptime, errors and performance are watched continuously, with alerts so issues are spotted before users report them.

included.title: Backups and recovery
included.text: Regular backups are taken and test-restored, so data can be recovered quickly if something goes wrong.

included.title: Performance tuning
included.text: We find slow pages and queries and fix them, keeping the app fast as data and users grow.

included.title: Small enhancements
included.text: Minor features and improvements can be added within the plan, so the software keeps up with how your team works.

pages.process_heading: How Our Maintenance and Support Works

process.title: Review
process.text: A 30-minute call and a check of your code, hosting, backups and open issues.

process.title: Agree
process.text: We agree on service levels, contact paths and what is included each month.

process.title: Stabilize
process.text: Urgent fixes and missing backups or monitoring are handled first.

process.title: Maintain
process.text: Updates, patches and fixes on a regular cycle, with a monthly summary.

process.title: Improve
process.text: We suggest and plan improvements based on errors, usage and your feedback.

faqs.q: Can you support software that another team built?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a review of the code, hosting and documentation, fix urgent issues and fill gaps such as backups or monitoring, then take over regular maintenance.

faqs.q: What service levels do you offer?
faqs.a: Response and fix times are agreed with you based on how critical the system is. They are written down, so both sides know what to expect.

faqs.q: Are security updates included?
faqs.a: Yes. Keeping frameworks, libraries and servers patched is part of maintenance, not an extra.

faqs.q: How do we report an issue?
faqs.a: Through an agreed channel such as email or a ticket portal. Every issue gets a reference, a priority and updates until it is closed.

faqs.q: Can the plan include new features?
faqs.a: Small enhancements can be included. Larger features are estimated separately so your monthly plan stays predictable.

pages.intro: Off-the-shelf CRMs force your team into someone else's process. We build a custom CRM around your sales flow: leads, deals, tasks and support in one place, with alerts, email sync and dashboards, connected to the systems you already use. You work with a custom enterprise software development company led by Indigenous tech workers.
bullets: Free 30-minute call to map your sales and support flow

Connected to your email, website and other systems

pages.included_heading: What Our Custom CRM Development Services Include

included.title: Lead and contact management
included.text: Capture leads from your website, email and forms, avoid duplicates and see each contact's full history in one view.

included.title: Deals and pipeline

included.title: Tasks, alerts and automation

pages.process_heading: How We Build Your Custom CRM

process.title: Discover
process.text: A 30-minute call and workshops on how leads, deals and support move today.

process.title: Design
process.text: We agree on stages, fields, roles, automations and the first dashboards.

process.title: Build
process.text: The CRM is built in small sprints with weekly demos your sales team can try.

process.title: Migrate and launch
process.text: We import and clean existing contacts and deals, train your team and go live.

process.title: Support
process.text: Fixes, new automations and integrations as your process changes.

faqs.q: Why build a custom CRM instead of using an off-the-shelf one?
faqs.a: A custom CRM fits your process instead of the other way around, has only the features your team uses, and has no per-user licence fees. It makes most sense when your sales or service flow is specific or off-the-shelf tools need many workarounds.

faqs.q: Can you move our data from our current CRM or spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Yes. We import contacts, companies, deals and history, clean duplicates and check the results with your team before launch.

faqs.q: Will it connect to our other systems?
faqs.a: Yes. Common connections include email and calendar, your website forms, ERP and accounting tools. We map these during design.

faqs.q: Who owns the CRM?
faqs.a: You do: the code, the data and the documentation. You are not locked into a vendor.

faqs.q: How do you keep customer data secure?
faqs.a: Role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, single sign-on, audit logs and regular backups are part of the build.
